CustomField.description: API name of the lookup of Fund_Field_ApplicabilityHistory__c pointing to this object (e.g. Share_Class_Reference__c). Used by FieldHistoryLogger to link the history lines and by FundFieldApplicabilityHistoryHandler to find their record: tracking a new object only needs its lookup field and this config record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: API name of the lookup field on Fund Field Applicability History that points to this object.
CustomField.label: Lookup Field API Name
